en: Black‑and‑white view of a small coastal resort town backed by dry, chaparral‑covered hills. A curved shoreline is lined with hotels and commercial buildings facing the water. Numerous small rowboats and a few larger passenger vessels fill the calm harbor, with a wooden pier extending into the bay. Houses climb the hillside behind the waterfront. The border and perspective suggest a vintage postcard or promotional photograph.
